caa.config.client.title: Client
caa.config.keep_flying_on_ground.1: Prevents players from automatically exiting flight mode when touching the ground.

caa.config.qol.title: QoL
caa.config.tweaks.belt_funnel_detection_: Allows funnels to extract items positioned exactly at the center of a belt.
Previously, funnels could only extract items past the center.
When a opposing funnel blocks items at the center, all side-facing belt funnels stop extracting, which is unintuitive.
Set the spout's fluid capacity to 2000 mB.
caa.config.tweaks.heuristic_rotation.1: Allow rotation for blocks without a custom rotate implementation.
caa.config.tweaks.heuristic_rotation.2: Many mod authors do not override rotate and mirror when adding directional blocks.
caa.config.tweaks.heuristic_rotation.3: As a result, vanilla structure block placement and Create schematic printing are unable to correctly rotate these blocks.
caa.config.tweaks.heuristic_rotation.4: Enabling this feature automatically detects common facing properties and applies rotation/mirror.
caa.config.tweaks.no_depot_overflow_drop: Prevent the depot from dropping overflow items.
For example when it accumulates too many processing outputs.
Or when an Ejector cannot merge received item stacks.
caa.config.tweaks.replace_any_flowing_fl: Allow pumps to replace any flowing fluid, ignoring the fluid type.
caa.config.tweaks.harvester_not_consume_: Prevent harvester from consuming seed when replanting.
caa.config.tweaks.disable_dig_speed_pena: When players are in the air or water, they will no longer be subject to a five-time increase in digging time penalty
caa.config.tweaks.better_psi_on_carriage: PSIs on trains are now only activated when the train arrives at a station.
caa.config.tweaks.hachimi_glue.1: Make super glue as convenient as honey glue from Aeronautic.

caa.config.normalization.deployer.1: Set the Deployer’s full-speed processing time to 5 ticks.
Set the Crushing Wheel’s full-speed processing time equals to recipe time and default value to 30 ticks.
caa.config.normalization.item_drain.1: Set the Item Drain's rolling time to 10 ticks and recipe time to 10 ticks.
caa.config.normalization.millstone.1: Set the Millstone's full-speed processing time equals to recipe time.
caa.config.normalization.mixer.1: Set the Mechanical Mixer's default full-speed processing time to 15 ticks.
caa.config.normalization.press.1: Set the Mechanical Press's full-speed processing time to 10 ticks.
caa.config.normalization.saw.1: Set the Mechanical Saw's full-speed processing time to 10 ticks each bulk.
caa.config.normalization.spout.1: Set the Spout's processing time to 20 ticks.
caa.config.normalization.chute.1: Set the Chute's default transport time to 5 ticks.
caa.config.normalization.pump.1: Multiply the fluid network transfer speed by 8.
caa.config.normalization.pump.2: Increase fluid flow propagation speed to 16 blocks/tick.
caa.config.normalization.depot.1: Set the Depot item movement animation duration to 5 ticks.
caa.config.normalization.valve.1: Set the Valve state toggle duration at full speed to 1 tick.
